lastRequest: Build a modern AI-powered Personal Study Assistant that helps students study smarter. It should allow users to upload PDFs, DOCX, PPTs, images, and handwritten notes, chat with uploaded study materials, summarize chapters, explain concepts at different difficulty levels, generate quizzes and flashcards, create personalized study plans, track progress, solve doubts with AI, generate mock tests, analyze diagrams, provide interview preparation, support voice input and text-to-speech, maintain study history, and offer a beautiful responsive dashboard with dark/light mode. Use React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Prisma, JWT authentication, vector search for document retrieval, AI provider abstraction (OpenAI, Gemini, Groq, Anthropic), Docker, REST API, testing, documentation, and a production-ready architecture.

tasks.title: Database Schema and Core Models
tasks.description: Design and implement PostgreSQL database schema using TypeORM or Prisma for users, study plans, flashcards, progress tracking, and AI interaction logs.

tasks.title: Backend API and AI Service Integration
tasks.description: Implement Express backend with TypeScript, secure JWT auth, repository pattern, error handling middleware, and integration with LLM provider for study generation.

tasks.title: Frontend Core Setup and Routing
tasks.description: Initialize React Vite application with Tailwind CSS, TypeScript, state management, Axios API client, routing, and authentication views.

tasks.title: Study Workspace and AI Feature Components
tasks.description: Develop interactive study dashboard, flashcard review system, quiz interface, and AI study plan generator components with responsive design.

tasks.title: End-to-End Testing and Production Hardening
tasks.description: Perform comprehensive code review, security hardening, environment configuration, input validation, and production build verification.
